name: Cold restart preserves original Ayleid Cask cancellation or successful loot

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local timer=0
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt; timer=timer+dt;if timer<.1 then return end;timer=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during short cask dive')
 print('VilverinContinue sample sim='..t..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' game='..core.getGameTime())
 print(string.format('VilverinContinue dive sample health=%.6f eye=%.3f z=%.3f',Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current,camera.getPosition().z,self.position.z))
 local target=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x66e79))
 local aim=target.position+util.vector3(0,0,35)
 local v=aim-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y)
 local c=aim-camera.getPosition();local pitch=-math.atan2(c.z,math.sqrt(c.x*c.x+c.y*c.y))
 print(string.format('VilverinContinue cask aim x=%d y=%d',math.floor(yaw*512+.5),math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*512+.5)))
 if self.position.z<-2975 then print('VilverinContinue dive reached cask') end
end}}}}
